_comment: Template sources are VERIFY by default. Never guess a URL; open the current CFP/author kit, then run: papercraft template --venue <id> --url <official-kit-url>. The URL is cached in paper_state/template-source.json.

_default.name: Generic
_default.notes: Use the official template for the target venue; do not reuse another year's style.

aaai.name: AAAI
aaai.notes: Find the current Author Kit on aaai.org; the style/version changes per year.

neurips.name: NeurIPS
neurips.notes: Use the current year's style file from the NeurIPS CFP/author kit.

icml.name: ICML
icml.notes: Use the current ICML style package from the conference site.

iclr.name: ICLR
iclr.notes: Use the current ICLR style package from the conference site.

acl.name: ACL
acl.notes: ACL style files are distributed via the ACL rolling review / acl-org style repository; verify the current version.

emnlp.name: EMNLP
emnlp.notes: Same ACL style family; verify the current ARR/EMNLP requirement.

cvpr.name: CVPR
cvpr.notes: Use the current CVPR author kit (IEEE format); do not reuse last year's kit.

kdd.name: KDD
kdd.notes: Use the current ACM master template/author kit specified by KDD.

chi.name: CHI
chi.notes: Use the current ACM CHI template; contribution type may change the format.

tmlr.name: TMLR
tmlr.notes: Use the current TMLR style package from the journal site.
